title: Mixed Event — Show Your Shine — Episode3 An Unexpected Request

meta.Event Outline: On her way to replace her torn jacket at the mall, Kanade has an encounter with Saki that leads to them setting up a teatime chat. That's when Saki asks her to be the model for her fashion project, of all things...!

rows.Line: A few days later
Cafe

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ahem...
Thank you all very much for agreeing to gather here today!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Uhh... You're welcome?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This is how Saki always acts, so please feel free to talk like you usually do, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe♪ I'm just really happy about the three of us meeting together like this today!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I've been wanting to ask you all about songwriting and stuff, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Songwriting... That's right, I got to listen to the song you made for Shibu Schools Fest before.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It was a good song.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wow, thank you so much!
Your advice ended up being huge since it was my first time writing a song for a musical!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You see things from a different perspective, Kanade... You caught things that we missed, and we learned so much.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see. It's nice to hear that I was able to help, even just a little...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe♪ I'm so glad that I got to thank you again like this!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Anyway, when it comes to songwriting...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I see. So, movies and manga are sometimes the sources of inspiration for your songs!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, as well as art.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It could be the feel of a particular piece, or just me wondering why the artist chose to draw it the way they did... I try to turn those feelings into sound.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wh-Whoa!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'll try to watch more movies and look at more works of art moving forward!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I might start doing that as well.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sorry. Our conversation just reminded me about something interesting we were recently assigned for art class.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, are you talking about that art project?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Art project?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yes! The theme is “radiance”.
We're supposed to create something...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We were told that as long as it keeps with the theme, we can go with a drawing, a sculpture, a movie or any other medium!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, interesting... Does that mean a song also works?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Unfortunately, a song alone isn't allowed since it's for art class.
But a video that incorporates one is, or a children's book that makes sounds, for example.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I see...
That sounds difficult, but also really fun.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Have you two already decided what you're going to make?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I'm thinking about drawing Miku.
I thought I should take this opportunity to try doing something I normally don't.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: A drawing of Miku seems like the perfect choice for you, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm thinking about a fashion piece that involves designing an outfit, as well as doing hair and makeup!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Your piece is going to involve all three...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yes!
Our art teacher showed us some of the things that former students made in the past.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That was when I found a picture of someone wearing an outfit her friend had coordinated according to the theme. The designer even did her hair and makeup...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I also saw that, and it was gorgeous.
She looked like a professional model...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
I wanna try doing that!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Come to think of it...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You seem to know quite a lot about fashion, Tenma...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I'm really not that knowledgeable!
But I do like following what's in and watching makeup videos.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I want to make the most of this opportunity and do something challenging!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. You have been really excited ever since we left art class that day.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: By the way, have you already found a model?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh... No, not yet...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Are you not allowed to be your own model, Tenma?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, that's allowed.
But I'm hoping to find someone to model for me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I kind of have this rough idea of what I want to do.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I wouldn't be able to pull off that look in a million years.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's why I was hoping to find a model who can...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What's wrong, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: She's the answer...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Umm, Kanade...?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, I know this is asking a lot of you, and feel free to say no...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But would it be possible for you to be my model?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I'm having trouble putting it into words...
But you possess the exact sort of radiance that I'm trying to capture!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
But I've never done any modeling before...
I'm not sure I'll be able to do your piece justice.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Not a problem!
If it's you, Kanade... I just know that you'll do an amazingly good job!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh no! I'm sorry!
I didn't mean to startle you or anything...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Me? As a model...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I honestly don't think I'm cut out to be one...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But Tenma helped me a lot the other day, so I do want to return the favor somehow.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay...
If you believe I'm the right person...then I accept.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: R-Really?! Are you sure?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I still don't know if I'll do a good job...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I promise to do my best.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you so much, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I...! I promise I'll find a way to make you as radiant and brilliant as possible!!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
O-Okay.
But please go easy on me...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank goodness.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'll need some time to pick out an outfit and practice doing hair and makeup...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, I'll let you know when I've got my plan of action!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, is there anything I need to do on my end...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Nope! You don't have to lift a finger!
I'll take care of your outfit and stuff!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, that's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Kanade as a model...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
You have me curious now...
Would it be alright if I came and watched?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I don't mind. Would that be okay, Tenma?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yes, that's totally okay!
So, Ichi, I'll also let you know when everything is ready!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks.
I'm actually pretty excited.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Me... As a model...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Will I really be able to pull it off...?)
